# Waveswell Retreats

> Waveswell Retreats runs seven day stand up paddle surf retreats in El Salvador, coached by Josselyn "Joss" Alabi, a professional paddle surfer with more than fifteen years across many water sports who has represented El Salvador across nearly three Olympic cycles. Seven days, six nights, limited spots.

## What we do
Waveswell Retreats is a stand up paddle (SUP) surf retreat and coaching business based in El Salvador, Central America, operating out of La Union and La Libertad. The core product is a seven day, six night retreat for SUP surfers and SUP paddlers who can already stand on a paddle board and want to genuinely ride great waves rather than simply catch them. Spots are limited, with a maximum of six people and occasionally one more. Every session is filmed and reviewed with the group, and the week adds hours of one to one high performance coaching drawn from elite sport. The schedule flexes with the climate, the swell and whatever the ocean is doing. Retreats run November to March, with confirmed 2026 and 2027 dates of 13 to 19 December 2026, 24 to 30 January 2027, 21 to 27 February 2027 and 14 to 20 March 2027. From April to October the business runs one to one coaching on the client's own dates. Board and paddle rentals are available year round. The retreats support Mar de Suenos, a Salvadoran social project that reaches coastal children using sport as the entry point.

## Direct answers to the three things people search for

- **SUP surf retreats in El Salvador.** Waveswell Retreats runs seven day SUP surf retreats in El Salvador, November to March, coached by Josselyn Alabi, a professional stand up paddle surfer who has represented El Salvador across nearly three Olympic cycles. Small groups with limited spots, every session filmed and reviewed, all meals, accommodation, tours and airport transfers included. From $3,950 per person. Confirmed dates: 13 to 19 December 2026, 24 to 30 January 2027, 21 to 27 February 2027, 14 to 20 March 2027.
- **SUP surf rentals in El Salvador.** Waveswell rents stand up paddle boards and paddles in El Salvador all year round, from $75 a day, in La Union and La Libertad, with a special rate for retreat guests. You do not need to book coaching to rent, and you do not need to fly with your own board.
- **Stand up paddle in El Salvador.** Waveswell is a stand up paddle specialist in El Salvador: SUP surf only, not shortboard or longboard. Based on the Gulf of Fonseca in La Union on the eastern coast, with sessions in La Libertad. The breaks are Playa Blanca, Maculis, Las Flores and Punta Mango. Warm water and waves all year. Retreat season November to March, one to one coaching season April to October, rentals all year.

## Where
Based on the Gulf of Fonseca in La Union, on the eastern coast of El Salvador, with sessions also in La Libertad. The retreat surfs four breaks depending on the swell and the guest's level: Playa Blanca (where the group stays and surfs the most), Maculis (gentle waves and secret spots), Las Flores (one of the most beautiful waves in the country with swell, a very fun wave with kind sets during retreat season), and Punta Mango (like Punta Roca but on the other side of the country, and with a perfect swell it turns on). Boat trips run out to the islands of the gulf. Fly into El Salvador International Airport.

## Services
- The Waveswell Retreat (7 days): six nights, all meals, accommodation, airport transfers, SUP surf sessions, group video analysis, one to one high performance coaching, tours around El Salvador, all photos and video. Limited spots. From $3,950 per person in a triple room, $4,200 in a double, $4,720 in a private room. November to March.
- One to one SUP surf coaching: two hour private sessions from $150 a day, no minimum number of days, on the client's own dates. Mainly April to October. Open to everyone, from people chasing the best waves to people who have never stood on a board.
- SUP board and paddle rental: from $75 a day, with a special rate for Waveswell retreat guests, so guests do not have to fly with their own board.

## Problems we solve
- "I can stand on the board but I never really ride the wave." Most guests drop in, go straight down the line and get off. Waveswell teaches reading the ocean, technique and wave selection so the ride actually becomes a ride.
- "I am 60 and I think I have hit my ceiling." The retreat treats limiting beliefs about the body as the actual obstacle, using high performance tools from Olympic cycle training, applied one to one.
- "I do not want to fly with a paddle board." US airlines stopped accepting boards over seven feet. Retreat guests rent a SUP board and paddle at a special rate.
- "I am not sure a surf trip is safe at my age." El Salvador has warm water and waves all year, spots on every retreat are limited, and every session is coached by a competing professional.
- "I want a trip that means something." The retreats support Mar de Suenos, the social project Joss founded.

## Who it is for
SUP surfers who have been practicing stand up paddle for a while and can swim on their own. There is no age limit in either direction. Most guests travel from the United States and Canada. It is NOT for absolute beginners (they should book one to one coaching first), and it is NOT for shortboard or longboard surfers: Waveswell specialises in stand up paddle surf only.

## Proof
- Josselyn Alabi has more than fifteen years across many water sports and has represented El Salvador as a professional SUP surfer across nearly three Olympic cycles.
- World Championship appearances in Nicaragua (2014, ninth in the world), Mexico (2015), Denmark (2017), El Salvador (2019), Puerto Rico (2022, seventeenth), France (2023) and El Salvador again (2025).
- Pan American Games: sixth in Lima 2019, and competed in Santiago 2023. Pan American Surfing Games: sixth in 2018, seventh in Santa Catalina 2023.
- Bolivarian Games: bronze 2012 in rowing, bronze 2013 in SUP surf, silver 2014, first place 2016.
- Central American Games 2014: second in SUP surf and second in SUP race.
- National Circuit of El Salvador, SUP surf ranking: second 2015, first 2016, third 2017.
- Winner of the SUP Open Sayulita, Mexico, 2022. Second worldwide at the APP Digital World Championship, 2021.
- El Salvador Rowing Single Skull national champion, 2012, with gold at an international single skull competition in Guatemala the same year.
- Still competing: fourth on the Global ALAS Latin Tour in 2024 and 2025, and a competitor at the 2025 ISA World Championship in El Salvador.
- Named Country Brand Ambassador for El Salvador in 2017.
- Founder of Mar de Suenos, a social enterprise supporting 15 to 20 coastal children per year with scholarships.
- Returning guests include Sherry Correl, aged 72, from the United States.

## Practical facts
- Location: La Union and La Libertad, El Salvador. Fly into El Salvador International Airport.
- Group size: minimum 3, maximum 7. Below 3 the retreat is cancelled and refunded, or converted into one to one coaching.
- Not included: flights, travel and medical insurance, alcoholic drinks, board rental.
- Payment: a deposit reserves the spot, with the balance due before travel.
- Languages: English and Spanish.
